transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hello, Doctor. It’s very nice to meet you, and thank you for taking the time to see me. I, um... I hope I'm explaining this the right way. I don't want to come across as a difficult person or a complainer, because I really do pride myself on being a good employee. I'm a computer support specialist. But I'm here because for over a year now, I’ve just been trying to get someone to take me seriously about what's going on at my office. 

There's this new ticket rotation system and these constant security audits, and... well, it's become quite clear that they are being used to build a paper trail against me. I've tried to bring it up politely, but management just keeps showing me system logs and telling me it’s just standard policy. I know how it might sound to an outsider, and I really don't want you to think badly of me, but I know what I'm seeing. Does that make sense? I just... I just need someone to understand what's actually happening.
Have you considered any other explanation for what’s happening at work?

I... well, I really have tried to. I promise you, I have. I know how important it is to be a team player, and I’d much rather this all just be a big misunderstanding. 

When management sat down and showed me the system logs, telling me it was just standard policy, I... I really tried to accept that. I asked myself if maybe I was just overthinking things. I hope you don't think I'm the type of person who just jumps to conclusions or looks for trouble. I try very hard to be agreeable. 

But... um, it’s been over a year now. And when you look at how the new ticket rotation always isolates my work, combined with those specific security audits... it’s just so clear that it's being used to build a paper trail against me. I've tried to find any other explanation because, frankly, it would be a lot less stressful if it really was just a policy update. But I can't ignore what's happening right in front of me. 

Am I making sense? I really just want to be reasonable about all this, and I hope you can see that I'm trying to look at it objectively.
